# Synkn

> Synkn builds free Android apps and browser-based tools that simplify everyday life and work, and offers custom mobile, web and backend development. Android apps: Battery Alarm, SalonHour, FocusDesk, SlabStack and PaintHue. Web app: SyncZone. For project inquiries, use the contact page.

## Core Platforms

- [Synkn](https://synkn.app/): Synkn builds free Android apps and browser-based tools that simplify everyday life and work, and offers custom mobile, web and backend development. Android apps: Battery Alarm, SalonHour, FocusDesk, SlabStack and PaintHue. Web app: SyncZone. For project inquiries, use the contact page.


## Android apps   
- [Battery Alarm](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.synkn.battery_alarm): Battery Alarm is a free, offline Android utility app that sounds an alert when your battery reaches a custom upper or lower charge level, for example the 20-80% range. It helps you unplug or plug in at the right time to reduce overcharging, heat and deep-discharge stress on lithium-ion batteries. It has no ads, needs no account and collects no data. Available on Google Play. [Website page](https://synkn.app/battery-alarm/)   
- [SalonHour](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.synkn.glowsync): SalonHour is an Android app for salon owners and beauty businesses. It manages specialists, services, packages, customers and appointments, and gives every business its own shareable booking page URL for direct customer booking. A web portal gives the front desk a simple view. Free plan with 20 appointments per month; Premium subscription unlocks unlimited usage. [Website page](https://synkn.app/salon-hour/)   
- [FocusDesk](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.synkn.focus_desk): FocusDesk is an Android ambient study and productivity companion that keeps your screen awake as a desk display. It combines Pomodoro, countdown and stopwatch timers, a day planner with daily, weekly and one-time tasks, group alarm audio cues, downloadable ambient soundscapes that play offline, and an overnight desk glow in Amber, Emerald or Purple. No account is needed. Available on Google Play. [Website page](https://synkn.app/focus-desk/)   
- [SlabStack](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.synkn.slab): SlabStack is a free offline one-tap isometric stacking game for Android. Drop moving slabs onto a tower in three shape modes (Rectangle, Cylinder and Triangle), with procedural color shifts, no data collected and a 3+ rating. Available on Google Play. [Website page](https://synkn.app/slab-stack/)   
- [PaintHue](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.synkn.paint_hue): PaintHue is a free Android coloring app that combines guided Tap-to-Fill coloring of vector templates with a pencil Sketch brush and a Free Draw canvas. It includes 200+ outline templates, a custom color picker with opacity control, ambient soundtracks, progress tracking and PNG export to the device gallery. Levels and sounds are downloaded once, then play offline. [Website page](https://synkn.app/paint-hue/)   
- [TideShift](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.synkn.tideshift): TideShift is a free offline pixel-art platformer for Android. Run, double jump and wade through water, find the hidden SWIM switch to unlock swimming, then dive for stars across 500 levels in 10 worlds. No account needed. [Website page](https://synkn.app/tide-shift/)

## Website   
- [SalonHour](https://salonhour.app/): SalonHour is an Android app for salon owners and beauty businesses. It manages specialists, services, packages, customers and appointments, and gives every business its own shareable booking page URL for direct customer booking. A web portal gives the front desk a simple view. Free plan with 20 appointments per month; Premium subscription unlocks unlimited usage. [Website page](https://synkn.app/salon-hour/)   
- [SyncZone](https://sync-zone.synkn.app/): A client-side meeting coordination workspace architected specifically for cross-border project managers and business development professionals. Operating entirely within the browser with zero server dependencies, it provides an interactive 24-hour timeline slider to calculate peak availability overlap across multiple timezones. Features include a global client directory linked directly to local timezone hooks, pre-calculated target meeting cards with action item checklists, system calendar integration (.ics exports), and secure backup management via standalone local JSON states. [Website page](https://synkn.app/sync-zone/)
